Close-up photos of the screen edges, bezel, and back panel.

response.reason: The model is clearly identified as Samsung 85Q60T from the screen display in both photos. The size, brand, and key features (QLED, 4K, HDR) are supported. While some claims like AirPlay and Alexa are unverifiable remotely, the item can be priced at its worst case (as used, possibly missing features) based on visible identity and condition. Hidden risks are noted and priced conservatively until proven.
